tools.name: search_reports
tools.description: Reports from the last 7 days, newest first: what a named public source reported, where and when, with the source type and location precision. Filter by words, region and type.

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: One public report by its id (the number in warstrikes.com/event/<id>-…), with its source, precision, the nearest infrastructure and nearby reports.

tools.name: get_daily_briefing
tools.description: The daily briefing for a UTC date (default: yesterday): what public sources reported that day, by region, every item linked to its report.

tools.name: list_regions
tools.description: The conflict regions WarStrikes follows, with report counts for the last 24 hours and 7 days and the region page.

tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Requires a WarStrikes API key with the Events layer. Events: one occurrence linked to all the reports that describe it, with precision, entities, sectors and impacts. Same filters as GET /api/v1/events.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Requires a WarStrikes API key with the Events layer. One Event by id, with its evidence and revision.

tools.name: search_signals
tools.description: Requires a WarStrikes API key with the Signals layer. Signals: WarStrikes assessments of severity, confidence and materiality. Same filters as GET /api/v1/signals, plus severity, confidence and materiality.

tools.name: get_signal
tools.description: Requires a WarStrikes API key with the Signals layer. One Signal by id.
